editorial.premise: The climbing game spends surprising detail on a quiet survival routine involving hot chocolate and rearranging supplies.
editorial.payoff: The small, ordinary routine makes the extreme climb feel tangible and human.
editorial.novelty_reason: Warm survival equipment and rest rather than dramatic cliffs or late-game reveals.
